name: 3D Rotation
description: A 3D rotation effect that spins and tilts your visuals. Ideal for product showcases, logo reveals, and dynamic motion graphics.

name: Card Flip
description: A smooth card flip animation that reveals content with a 3D rotation effect. Perfect for product showcases, app UI animations, and interactive mockups.

name: Color Keying Effect
description: A color keying effect that isolates and replaces a specific color in your footage. Ideal for compositing and green screen-style animations.

name: Dithering Effect
description: A dithering effect that renders your visuals with an animated noise pattern. Great for retro-style motion graphics and textured video content.

name: Gooey Effect
description: A fluid gooey effect that blends and morphs shapes with a liquid-like animation. Perfect for playful transitions and organic motion graphics.

name: Grainy Color Clamp
description: A grainy color clamp effect that maps your footage to a limited color palette. Perfect for editorial and retro-style motion graphics.

name: Highlight Effect
description: An animated highlight effect that draws attention with a sweeping light motion. Perfect for social media and ads..

name: Holographic Logo
description: A holographic logo animation that renders your brand mark with a shimmering, iridescent foil effect. Perfect for premium product reveals and high-end brand animations.

name: Image Stretch Transition
description: An image stretch transition that warps and pulls your visuals into the next scene. Great for dynamic video editing and social media reels.

name: Inward Echo Loop
description: An inward echo animation that layers repeating shapes into a hypnotic looping effect. Perfect for abstract motion graphics and animated backgrounds.

name: Pixel Dissolve Transition
description: A pixel dissolve transition that fragments your visuals into an animated pixel grid. Ideal for product reveals, stylized transitions, and social media content.

name: Pixelated Mask
description: A pixelated mask effect that reveals or hides your content through an animated pixel grid. Great for stylized transitions and retro motion graphics.

name: Pixelated Slideshow
description: A pixelated slideshow transition that dissolves between images through an animated pixel effect. Great for presentations and social media content.

name: Ring Scale: Animated Loop
description: A looping ring scale animation that pulses and scales in perfect rhythm. Great for intros, badges, and attention-grabbing motion graphics.

name: Ripple Effect
description: A ripple effect that sends animated waves across your visuals. Great for fluid transitions, water simulations, and dynamic motion graphics.

name: Threshold Effect
description: A high-contrast threshold effect that converts your visuals into monochrome. Ideal for bold, graphic animations.
